hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Side-door stripper (packoff)
function: The hydraulic seal around the moving coil at the top of the stack: pistons squeeze an elastomer element onto the pipe so the well stays sealed while the coil runs.

tabs.overview: The side-door design lets the element be changed with the coil in the stack by opening a door; conventional and radial designs exist (S24). Element life depends on pressure, speed, and how clean the coil is; a second stripper is sometimes stacked as a spare.
tabs.engineering: Dynamic pressure ratings are below the BOP rating (S24); element size per the coil.
tabs.safety: Element change on a live well needs two barriers below (pipe rams and a second seal) (S24).
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
